units: <cite ref="Pesachim 22b:6">Pes. 22ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 21:28">Ex. XXI, 28</cite>) as one says to his neighbor <he>יצא פלוני נ׳ מנכסיו</he> that man went out of his possessions empty-handed; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 41a:18">B. Kam. 41ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 41b:9">Ib. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ מחצי כופר</he> free from paying the half-fine.
<cite ref="Taanit 23a:13">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 22:30">Job XXII, 30</cite>) <he>דור שלא היה נ׳ וכ׳</he> thou hast saved with thy prayer a generation which was not clear from sin.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:8">Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:19">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 5:17">Koh. V, 17</cite>) <he>שמור … שתהא טהור ונ׳</he> guard thy foot, that thou be pure and guiltless when thou art called to the house of God; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 62b">Erub. 62ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קב ונ׳</he> only a Kab (little in quantity), but well-sifted (v. infra).—(Adv.) <he>נְקֵי נדר</he>, <he>נ׳ שבועה</he> without vow (as an oath), without oath; or: cleared by means of a vow &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:10">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01202"><he>נִקָּיוֹן</he></cite>.
Gitt. IX, 10 נְקִיֵּי הדעת the pure-minded; a. e.—Fem. נְקִיָּה, נְקִיָּיה.
<cite ref="Niddah 31b:23">Nidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>נ̇ק̇ב̇ה̇ נ̇ק̇ייה ב̇אה</he> a female comes into the world poor (without the means of making a livelihood).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ</cite> <he>דעתו נ׳</he> his mind is clear (he is wise).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:9">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין דעתן נ׳</he> their minds are not clear enough (for esoteric wisdom).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:30">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>כדי שתהיי נ׳ לבעליך וכ׳</he> in order that thou be clean for thy husband through these waters.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:19">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>פת נ׳</he> bread of fine (sifted) flour; <cite ref="Pesachim 37a:7">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00151"><he>הַדְרָאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 82b:3">Kidd. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>אומנות נ׳ וקלה</he> a cleanly and easy trade; <cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 5:15">Tosef. ib. V, 15</cite>; a. fr.
